global.description: Platform values (global.okdp): the context's layers, the platform's (platform.yaml) then its project's (project.yaml), never an instance's.

rbacCreate.title: Create role
rbacCreate.description: A Role for Spark on Kubernetes (pods, services, configmaps, persistent volume claims, SparkApplications to read, to write with submitApplications; no secrets), bound to the ServiceAccount alone, and the ConfigMap <release>-pod-bounds that bounds the pods it creates (the platform's okdp-pod-bounds policy).

submitApplications.title: Submit SparkApplications
submitApplications.description: Let the ServiceAccount create, update and delete SparkApplications, for a task that submits them as this ServiceAccount (an Airflow task, its pod's serviceAccountName). Off, it reads them only: a Spark driver needs no more.

podSecrets.title: Secrets of the pods
podSecrets.description: The Secrets the pods the Spark jobs create may mount or read (volumes, secretKeyRef, envFrom): the S3 identities of the executors, for example. Nothing else of the namespace's Secrets, with the platform's okdp-pod-bounds policy.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

spark-rbac.title: spark-rbac
spark-rbac.description: Values of the spark-rbac chart 1.0.1 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/spark-rbac), the ServiceAccount of the Spark jobs (its Role is OKDP's, the chart's off): serviceAccount.annotations (a workload identity) in a privileged project only (the compiler denies the key serviceAccount to the others' upstream values). Refused: rbac (the chart's Role and RoleBinding, parameter rbacCreate), serviceAccount.name (parameter serviceAccountName). Appended: none.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
